Each outsider request is shown on your phone before the agent sees it. Approve once and that request runs to completion; the next request starts locked again. Sensitive data is still withheld from the reply.

Off by default, and this alone trusts nobody: per group you then send /review for Smart Review (an AI screens each request — only clearly low-risk, on-purpose ones run without a card; the rest still ask you) or /trust for no-approval; every other group keeps per-request approval. Card-free runs stay confined to that project\'s reads, edits and searches. Shell commands are unchanged — dangerous ones refused, anything unproven still asks you — and every card-free run is logged.
